notes.note: Deployment is observed with hostid("Ipv4") in the MTC; assumes the test system can deploy the MTC on host 127.0.0.1 (as in the C.6.3 example). Titan does not support the '-' TimerValue / HostId arguments of execute (syntax error); the test follows the BNF rule TestcaseInstance.
Uses an unresolvable host name (.invalid TLD) so that the MTC cannot be deployed; expected verdict error. Titan does not support the HostId argument (syntax error).
Titan rejects this module only because it does not parse a HostId argument at all, not because of the non-charstring type.
Terminology reading: actual parameter for a non-template formal parameter; a matching symbol (?) is used as the non-expression actual parameter.
The execute statement is placed directly in a test case body (the simplest test behaviour chain).

Actual values of module control function parameters are normally supplied by the tool/user; the test provides the value through a default value, which a self-contained test cannot avoid. It does not cover the case where no value is supplied.
Titan does not support a runs on clause on the module control function (syntax error); valid per FunctionDef BNF and clause 16.1.5.
Observed negatively: a control function without runs on cannot call a function that runs on a non-empty component type, since the created control component is empty.
Reading 1 (no control-flow statements). Order is made observable by passing the verdict of the first test case to the second; only assignments, no control-flow statements are used.
Titan does not support with statements on local definitions (syntax error); allowed by BNF rules FunctionBodyDef, AltstepLocalDef and ComponentDefList.
Members of a component type are referenced by an attribute qualifier; port type members are not covered. Titan only allows field qualifiers for record/set/union types.
Titan does not support with statements on local definitions (syntax error); allowed by BNF.

All executable 27.1.2.0 tests observe the effective attributes with the attribute retrieval operations of clause 27.8 (Type.display, value.encode), which Titan does not implement (syntax errors in tests 001-012, 014, 016-019).
Reading 1 (inner with overrides every enclosing with): checked over three nesting levels (module, group, type).
Reading 1: two encode attributes of a group are both overridden by a single encode attribute of a type in the group (consistent with 27.1.2.2).
Reading 1: a field of a type with an @local attribute inherits the module-level attribute.

Reading 1, based on example 6: lower declarations with their own override keep it, others (including attributes inherited from type references) get the group override. Does not check lower declarations with a non-override attribute, where the readings differ.
